notes.title: v0.8.0.0 Character Abilities Major Update
notes.notes:
This update presents three unique characters (agents) for you to choose from in single
player roguelike runs, each of which has two abilities.
"Backtrack" in the original game has been changed to a special ability of Epitaph's.
  [h3]Character Abilities:[/h3]
     [b]Agent Tic:[/b]

      Slingstickers:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30687164/b0884a2e1a1cf153d16aa32746432c7e3ed6539a.gif[/img]
      Slingstickers is a special weapon. You shoot a sticky bomb silently, which sticks to an enemy and explodes in a few seconds.

      Instinct:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30687164/cbc81d2cddfa563d8580f8b444044d0b1d704817.gif[/img]
      Allows you to know before you shoot if there are guards nearby able to hear the sound.

     [b]Agent Epitaph:[/b]

       Backtrack:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30687164/a6e6cacc16427fe5d495926c046fa5b804343b45.gif[/img]
       Allows you to teleport to any position on your track in a distance. You also leave a decoy at the place you started the ability. If you stand still with the decoy on, you are completely invisible until the decoy is destroyed.

       Concentration:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30687164/525481b7939d3929c3f720c38033c6371e173754.gif[/img]
       Time is slowed down when you are aiming.

      [b]Agent Spark:[/b]

       Auto Turret:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30687164/cd2ce80a4136f431130ae225c1cd968511faefb4.gif[/img]
       Spending three ore shards and place an auto turret which automatically shoots at any enemies on sight.

       Intimidation:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30687164/aa3567bb5e80c19accdb8b8b4ab33a292caf0380.gif[/img]
       You shout at enemies instead of clapping when pressing clap button.

[h3]New rescue system:[/h3] 
      you don't require another player to join to rescue captured agents. But the captured ones will be MIA in the entire ops if the mission is completed without them rescued.

[h3]Rescued agents can be possessed by new players at any time of the mission.[/h3]

[h3]Add tutorials in roguelike mode[/h3]

[h3]Removed Backtrack challenge under Training menu[/h3]

[h3]Improved portraits of characters[/h3]

[h3]UI Improvements:[/h3]
     Improved Ops Screen
     Moved World Activity to Ops Screen to reduce wait time
     Removed mission report screen. Now players just return to the mothership right away with mission report showing on screen. Wait time reduced.
     Improved game over screen
     Improved timeline UI

[h3]Mechanics Tweak:[/h3]
      Attacking a button will trigger it

[h3]Fixed some obsolete tips[/h3]

[h3]Added a feature for streamers by which you can have the audience interacting with you.[/h3] 
See https://zacx-z.github.io/signal-decay-streamplay/

notes.title: v0.7.2.0 Major Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone having been watching this game, especially to the players who sent feedbacks and bug reports to me. It's been extremely helpful. While the multiplayer mode provides a solid co-op experience, most of the complaints are about the single player mode: lack of tutorials, obscurity of the special ability, hard to pick up and lack of tools for stealth. This update is focused to solve the latter two issues.

This update mainly tweaks the difficulty of the single player mode, loose the system. It decreases the requirements for cooperation, but it also provides each player more space to explore ways of playing, which also generates more diversity. The rendering system is also changed, which improves the performance. New content players are calling on is added to unlock new ways of stealth.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Core Mechaninics[/h2]

 - Mechanics Simplification: Players are hidden in the dark even when running (except for when player is operating on something). Holding SHIFT only hides footsteps.
 - New Interaction Clap: Click on the player character or press R3 to clap. It creates noise and attract enemies.
 - New Interaction Kick: Press V to kick the guard off when grabbing him. The guard will be stunned for a short time.
 - Changes on Guard Radio Mechanics:
   * When a guard sees a player after his radio is turned on, an "investigate event" appears at his interest point.
   * Nearby guards patrol to the "investigate event" and search afterwards.
   * When guards finish searching, they will dismiss the "investigate event". Killing a guard won't dismiss the event.
   * Killing a guard with radio on won't result in alert level rise.
 - When a guard has radio on, he will report corpses in his sight immediate and raise the alert level.
 - A guard can see a corpse from far away.
 - Decrease the running speed of a guard investigating a gun shot.
 - A player will show up when getting hit.

[h3]Designer Notes:[/h3]

Considering most players' little fingers are not that flexible, I decided to reduce the required time and frequency of holding shift. It is hard to distinguish different states of the player with the character displayed in small visual form. So the decision is to simplify the light/stealth system, which makes it easier to understand the mechanics.

Changes in the radio mechanics are made for the issues in the narrative sense. From the feedbacks it seems stealth game players care about narrative meanings of mechanics a lot. Now the alert level has a significant rise only when a corpse is found. The players only need to stop the message from transmitting at any phase. Although the introduction of "investigate event"s  amplifies the snowball effects, it also brings more emergence. It is also a nerf on long-cool-down weapons in an indirect way.

[h2]New Content[/h2]

 - New Weapon Bow: Finally a silent ranged weapon. Charge to shoot. The point where the arrow disappears also creates noise that can be utilized to lure guards.
 - New Weapon Heat Rifle: Charge to shoot a heat laser. A heat wave will appear at the hit point which deals damage in the area through everything.
 - New Gadget Suppressor: Consumable. Use to install on the current gun. The next 6 shots will be silent.
 - New Gadget Radio Jammer: Consumable. Use to set up a radio jammer at the position. Blocks all the guard radio communication in an area.
 - New High Vol Producer - Espionage Tech: Produces Suppressors and Radio Jammers.
 - Tech Launcher Changes:
  - "Barefoot": 2 suppressors added.
  - "Raider": Pistol is replaced by Bow.
  - "Intruder": Rifle is replaced by Heat Rifle.
 - Guards can be stunned on bottle hits.

[h3]Designer Notes:[/h3]
On feedbacks about lack of stealth methods, this update provides new weapons and gadgets that reduce negative effects. A counter weapon is designed against shield guards: Heat Rifle. Bow and Heat Rifle are both charged weapons. The charge process can be interrupted by hits, so they are countered by high-frequency weapons.

[h2]Feedbacks Improvements[/h2]

 - Improved the SFX of radio.
 - improved the SFX and visuals of operating on everything.
 - Improved the SFX of pistols, rifles, sniper rifles. Added charge SFX of sniper rifle.
 - When player successfully kills a guard from behind, it will be visually emphasized with a mask effect.
 - Improved the appearance of noise indicator.
 - Improved the appearance of the enemy gaze.

[h3]Designer Notes:[/h3]
Emphasis of killing from behind makes the action more rewarding, and it is clearer that tactical shots are encouraged.

[h2]Technical Optimizations:[/h2]

 - Rendering system is replaced by deferred pipeline. The overall lighting effect is improved and glitches no longer exist.
 - Improved the rendering vision cones. Performance is much improved and the style of graphics is slightly changed.
 - Optimize loading process of the procedural map using an asynchronous method.

[h2]Mechanics Tweaks[/h2]

 - There is noise when a dead guard falls down.
 - A guard turns to face the location for a while on hearing a gun shot or receiving an "investigate event" and walk after the time.
 - Doors can be pass through a short time after open.
 - Gadget Stabilizer prevents charging attack process from being interrupted.
 - Shield guard will not remove tase state when shield blocks any damage.
 - Some adjustments on guard AI.

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
 - A guard can always hear noise when chasing and suspecting.
 - Fix some rendering issues.
 - Bugfix:  some mouse cursors can't be displayed with hardware cursor setting on.
 - Bugfix: opening windows on the mothership makes the player unable to shoot.
 - Bugfix: display issues of mission report screen and operation report screen.
 - Bugfix: Enforcer keeps attacking dead players.
 - Bugfix: In networked game the loadout window is misplaced on mission brief screen.
 - Bugfix: Friend activity list doesn't show current friends playing the game on entering the game, and display friends in different versions of the game.
 - Bugfix: Occasional bug that clients can't get in mission brief screen in networked game.
 - Bugfix: Acquiring medkits don't have SFX on clients in networked game.

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]

To mitigate the issue that the single-player special ability is too obscure, the future work will be focused on experimenting different special abilities. The next major update will bring new single-player special abilities, and there will be new enemy types and level features as well, to make the experience more diverse.

Stay tuned!

If you have any questions, or look for teammates to play together, join our official Discord: https://discord.gg/signaldecay

 - fix the issue that some guards might stuck at certain places in airport missions
 - optimize 2d physics performance
 - fix adult magazine can only be thrown twice
 - in networked games players can see the brief state of remote players loadout window on mission brief screen

If you have any questions, or look for match to make, join our official Discord: https://discord.gg/signaldecay

notes.title: v0.7.0.8 changelog
notes.notes:
- fix the issue that game may crash on Windows 7 or some Windows 10 machines
 - press F7 at any time to report bugs (automatically generate a pack and you need to send it to the developers)
 - you can quick restart the game on game over screen and in pause menu with your current Tech Launcher and your first mission's loadout. (You can also start from choosing Tech Launcher screen)
 - you can see the time bar of your teammate grabbing a guard in a networked game
 - won't reveal oneself when throwing grenades/items
 - opening doors is 20% faster
 - make the colliders of thrown bottles smaller
 - improve preview window of researching a tech module

notes.title: v0.7.0.7 changelog
notes.notes:
- editing key bindings function
 - fix the severe bug caused by exiting lobby and re-enter
 - improve the feel of backtracking
 - fix having to press twice using cursor when pause
 - fix bug in tutorial level caused by skipping conversations too fast
 - improve the button prompts of mines when using gamepads
 - make it easier to assassinate: enlarge assassinate hitbox, and the player moves a little bit when assassinating or grabbing a guard
 - improve the UI of joining friends games & training level

notes.title: v0.7.0.6 update patch notes
notes.notes:
1. Mouse sensitivity won't be set to zero
2. Friends activity list no more show non-friends
3. Join requests shown in the middle of a game has a limit of 20 seconds.
4. Fix the issue that alert level display could be stuck at a number and repeat showing rising signs.
5. Fix a rare bug that a player can't do anything after reviving from death.
6. Fix the issue that player moves slowly after being tased when using "Force Field".
7. Players joined via invites will skip inputing passwords.
8. Add prompts in the lobby and when restarting the game.

If you have any questions, or look for match to make, join our official Discord:  [url=https://discord.gg/XWMMvtU]https://discord.gg/XWMMvtU[/url]

notes.title: v0.7.0.5 changelog
notes.notes:
1. Added invite button in lobby so you can invite your friends to play a game together. You are able to kick others out as the host now. Improve the experience of using the lobby.

2. Added browser of notes, using which you can read the notes you get in a mission. There will more notes about mechanics and stories in the future.

3. Added more tips on some screens.

4. Improved the options screen.

5. Fixed AI of unarmed guards.

6. Daily challenge can only be unlocked by playing through all training levels.

7. Fixed severe bugs caused by rescue missions.

8. Adjust some numbers in the strategy part of the game.

9. Fixed some severe bugs in networking.

10. Added comm interaction of gamepads.

The function of editing keybindings is scheduled in the next regular update. Following updates will be focused on stability of multiplayer games. Thanks!

notes.title: Early Access release delayed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

From the playtest feedbacks, we feel the current state of Signal Decay is not ready to be released right now. We are improving the overall experience in these months, and planning to release around Jan 2018.

I have to say Signal Decay is a complex (and also deep) game that needs more time to think on teaching.

[olist]
[*] We are making a new experience picking up the game, to inform players the world settings and their goals/tools better, and generally creates less confusion.

[*] We are still making new content, including a new enemy type that are more friendly to new players.

[*] We are making UIs and everything clearer to understand.

[/olist]

Thanks for waiting! Please stay tuned!

Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/signaldecaygame/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/signaldecaygame]Twitter[/url]

-Zack (Basically the only developer all the time)
